_comment: Three monthly headline sentiment prints used as OBR growth-input proxies. (a) S&P Global UK Services PMI (licensed series; we mirror only the published press-release headline). (b) GfK/NIESR Consumer Confidence Barometer (headline index; sub-indices are subscription-gated). (c) RICS UK Residential Market Survey house-price balance (headline net percentage; full back-set is RICS-subscription). All three are lawful fair-use summaries of publicly released headline values. Refreshed monthly when each release drops. VINTAGE: mixed as of 2026-09-01. Services PMI and consumer confidence ship the August 2026 prints (PMI is the 21 Aug FLASH 52.8 — final due ~3 Sep; GfK -14 released 21 Aug). RICS August is not out until ~9 Sep, so rics_price_balance stays on the July final (-30). Each slot carries its own observed_at; the top-level observed_at is the oldest slot (RICS) so the 40-day assertFixtureFresh guard still trips when the slowest series goes stale. Replace the PMI flash with the August final when S&P publishes it.

services_pmi.source: S&P Global / CIPS UK Services PMI, August 2026 FLASH 52.8 (released 2026-08-21; consensus 51.8). Second consecutive expansion month, steepest since February. Flash per FXStreet quoting the official S&P print: https://www.fxstreet.com/news/united-kingdom-flash-services-pmi-expands-faster-to-528-in-august-beats-518-estimates-202608210833 — REPLACE with the final (~3 Sep) when it lands.

consumer_confidence.source: NIQ (GfK) Consumer Confidence Barometer, August 2026 release dated 2026-08-21: overall index up three points to -14, a two-year high (Reuters writeup of the GfK release: https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-consumer-confidence-jumps-two-year-high-gfk-says-2026-08-20/).

rics_price_balance.source: RICS UK Residential Market Survey, July 2026 (published 2026-08-13): aggregate net house-price balance -30%. August RMS due ~2026-09-09. Source PDF: https://www.rics.org/content/dam/ricsglobal/documents/market-surveys/UK-Residential-Market-Survey-July-2026.pdf
